summary: Validated welcome-letters bug fix end-to-end: backend endpoints (/info, /download, /start, /jobs/{id}, /jobs/{id}/download) all working; non-existent job_id correctly returns 404 (no 500). Frontend UI: login → Users → Padres → 'Cartas de bienvenida' button click triggers sync download, shows Spanish success toast, no InvalidStateError or Uncaught exceptions in console. [WELCOME-LETTERS] prefixed log appears as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: welcome_letters.py: temporary ZIP files in /tmp generated by _run_job have no TTL cleanup; multi-replica deploys may also lose the file across pods. Frontend gracefully shows the new 409 'Vuelve a generar...' but consider a janitor or S3-backed storage for production at scale.

Reuse risk: a successfully-downloaded job's ZIP is NOT deleted in welcome_job_download() (sync /download deletes its tmp file via _iter finally). Re-downloading the same job_id continues to work as long as the file exists, which matches the requested behaviour, but explicit retention policy should be documented.
_require_admin raises 400 for missing school_id; tests passed 401 unauthenticated check (FastAPI auth dep handles before _require_admin). Acceptable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_welcome_letters.py and cover /info, sync /download (returns valid ZIP with PDFs + _EXCLUIDOS.txt), full async flow (/start → polling /jobs/{id} → /jobs/{id}/download), 404 for unknown job_id on both status & download endpoints, and unauthenticated rejection. Subscription-expired modal blocks Users page on elroble; UI test removes it via JS DOM cleanup to reach the role tab. The 'Cartas de bienvenida' button has data-testid='welcome-letters-btn' and is visible only when viewing the parents role list.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause confirmed mitigated: (1) Backend: stale /tmp/welcome_<job>.zip after pod restart used to return generic 409; now returns descriptive Spanish detail per condition (status!=done, file_path empty, file missing). 404 'Job no encontrado' verified for random uuid (no 500). (2) Frontend: axios with responseType:'blob' previously caused 'InvalidStateError: Failed to read responseText' on error responses. The new catch block (UsersPage.jsx ~L2199-2211) reads err.response.data as Blob via .text() then JSON.parse, falling back to text — confirmed by console showing only the [WELCOME-LETTERS] log and no InvalidStateError. Happy path on elroble (6 families, sync) downloads ZIP and shows success toast.
